<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <title>Black circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      overflow: visible; /* keep antialiased edge pixels from being clipped */
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      circle { fill: CanvasText; }
    }
  </style>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
      <title id="circle-title">Black circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="#000"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I didn't change `0.html`, because it's already in good shape and I couldn't find anything clearly wrong with it. It draws a black circle centered on the page, and it already:

- scales with the screen (`min(400px, 90vmin)`, with `dvh` for mobile browsers)
- has a name for screen readers (`role="img"` with a linked `<title>`)
- works in Windows high-contrast mode (`forced-colors`)
- doesn't request a favicon (`href="data:,"`)
- still shows at 400×400 if the CSS doesn't load (the `width`/`height` attributes)

Any edit now would be a matter of taste rather than a fix. What kind of improvement did you have in mind? For example:

1. **Dark mode:** a white circle on a black background when the system is in dark mode.
2. **Looks:** a gradient, shadow or animation.
3. **Different use:** make the size or color configurable, or turn it into a reusable component.
4. **Smaller file:** strip it down to the fewest bytes possible.

Tell me which one, or something else, and I'll make the change.
